content:
OpenSearch Serverless emits the following Amazon CloudWatch Logs metrics at one-minute
intervals to help you monitor OCU utilization and capacity limits at the collection group level:
• IndexingOCU – The number of indexing OCUs currently in use by the collection group.
• SearchOCU – The number of search OCUs currently in use by the collection group.
OpenSearch Serverless also emits OCU metrics at the account level for collections not associated
with any collection group. You can aggregate these metrics in CloudWatch to visualize the sum of
OCUs across all collection groups and account-level collections.
Conﬁgure alarms to notify you when your collection group approaches its capacity limits so you
can adjust settings as needed. For more information about OpenSearch Serverless metrics, see the
section called “Monitoring OpenSearch Serverless”.
